sample_unit: claims extracted from LLM-generated diagnostic reports (36 patients, 4 models)

links.outcome: Share of claims in LLM diagnostic reports unsupported or lacking verified evidence chain
links.effect: 2.7% of claims unsupported (GPT-5.2 1.7% to Claude Opus 4.6 3.6%); 915 claims (30.2%) plausible but not fully verified; 32.9% not fully supported by direct evidence.
links.quote: However, mechanistic verification revealed a much larger plausibility gap: 915 claims (30.2%) were biologically reasonable but lacked a fully verified evidence chain, bringing the share of claims not fully supported by direct evidence to 32.9%.

unlisted_practices: Claim-level extraction and evidence verification of LLM-generated reports using a transparency engine
Cross-model comparison of claim agreement for the same patient data

screen.reason: Evaluates a claim-level transparency and verification pipeline (guardrail/audit framework) applied to LLM-generated diagnostic reports to detect ungrounded and unsupported medical claims.

primary.practice: claim-level mechanistic verification / automated evidence grounding audit
